name: Lucky Drunk's Mail
body:
Source Inner Sea Gods pg. 252
Aura faint enchantment and evocation CL 3rd
Slot armor; Price 4,840 gp; Weight 40 lbs.
Description
This +1 chainmail is decorated with a row of small metal disks, each stamped with a tankard symbol. The wearer gains a +1 luck bonus on all saving throws and can use moment of greatnessUC once per day.
Construction
Requirements Craft Magic Arms and Armor, divine favor, moment of greatnessUC; Price 2,570 gp
